name: Myau Orphel
source:
Yggdrasil Magical Academy First Year
Attribute: Magic Dragon

A member of a magic dragon tribe, she adores the [url=/c64356]protagonist[/url] because he once saved her life in the distant past, when she was injured and accidentally wandered into his world. Ever since that day, she has been unable to forget about him, and feels like it was destiny that he reappeared before her at the academy.  

Her name her was given to her by the protagonist, because when he found her, her cries her sounded like “Myau, Myau,“ and she has kept that name ever since. She always tries her hardest to help him in whichever way she can, doing his cleaning and laundry for him—though she may have ulterior motives for taking care of his laundry.  

Myau absolutely loves sweets, and works part-time at a maid café while studying magic at the academy.
